content:
marie: Heads-up — around 06:12 UTC we saw a sustained per-key 429 spike for acme-prod after their config rollout. Peak ~2k 429s/min for ~12m. Latency also increased.
raj: Seen the alert. Is this per-org soft limit kicking or something at the edge?
lina: Looks like our per-key burst window (30s) got overwhelmed, then fallback routing flooded the hosted pool.
ben_oncall: I'm on it. Can someone paste the alert query and thresholds so I can tune noise suppression?
marie: Alert we got (from yr-monitor-bot):
```
alert: PerKey429Spike
expr: sum by(api_key) (increase(http_responses_total{code="429"}[5m])) > 100
for: 2m
labels: severity=page
```
raj: That query is aggressive for large orgs. For per-org we should divide by sustained QPS or use rate per 1k tokens.
lina: Proposal: change to a two-tier alert: 1) per-api_key short-burst alert (high threshold, no page) 2) per-org sustained alert (lower threshold, page). That matches our routing tiers.
amanda_cs: From CS side — when we page we need an automatic ticket + suggested customer message template. Right now ops spends time drafting responses.
ben_oncall: Agreed. For now I'll mute the per-key pager and send a note to CS.
yr-monitor-bot: deploy-bot triggered: updated dashboard panels for per-key 429 heatmap (PR #4281) deployed to staging.
raj: Dashboard recommendations:
- Heatmap: per-key 429 rate (5m) with histogram buckets for burst length
- Timeseries: per-org rolling 30m 429 rate and fallback model traffic percent
- Table: top 50 keys by 429 spike + recent rollout tag

lina: Add a panel for routing fallback ratio (how often requests were routed to fallback model due to capacity/latency) — helps validate cascading behavior.
marie: Runbook draft (short):
1) Triage: check dashboard -> identify org/key and recent changes (deploys/rollouts).
2) If per-key burst only: apply ephemeral per-key soft-limit (30s backoff) via router API: `POST /internal/router/limits` with body `{key:, window:30s, soft: true, throttle: 20/s}`. No customer-facing page.
3) If per-org sustained: escalate to page, enable emergency quota bump for critical traffic, trigger canary rollback or targeted model downgrade.
4) CS: send templated message including safe fallback steps and estimated mitigation ETA.
5) Postmortem: capture rollout tag and routing decision in incidents board.

raj: Important: router API needs idempotent backfill semantics — when we add soft-limits we must ensure they expire automatically or are removed by name, otherwise we leave stale rules. Add `expires_at` metadata.
lina: Good call. I'll add `expires_at` to the API and UI control. Also adding a console action: "Create temporary soft-limit" that sets expiry and links to the runbook entry.
amanda_cs: Suggested CS templated text: "We're seeing intermittent rate limiting for your tenant tied to a deployment. We've applied a temporary mitigation and are investigating. Expected recovery within ~15-30 minutes. If you continue to see errors, share request IDs."
ben_oncall: For alert tuning: change the per-key alert to `> 500` for first-line (mute pager), and create `PerOrgSustained429` with expr: `sum by(org_id) (increase(http_responses_total{code="429"}[30m])) > 2000 and rate(requests_total[30m]) > 10` -> page.
marie: Also add jittered suppression to reduce alert storms when many keys spike simultaneously (randomized 30–90s window before creating a page).
raj: Telemetry changes: we should emit `fallback_reason` tag on requests (capacity|latency|quota) and expose in logs + dashboard. Helps CS understand why a customer saw degraded model.
lina: And a small UX change: in the console, show recent soft-limits and allow CS to propose a temporary quota increase request which SRE can approve with one click.
amanda_cs: Love that. Will reduce back-and-forth emails.
ben_oncall: I'll implement the alert changes and temporary mute for the noisy per-key alert. Will also add a runbook link in the alert annotation.
marie: Posting a checklist for follow-up actions:
- [ ] router API: add expires_at + idempotent rule id (owner: lina)
- [ ] console: "Create temporary soft-limit" action + UI (owner: lina)
- [ ] alerts: adjust thresholds & add per-org sustained alert (owner: ben_oncall)
- [ ] dashboards: heatmap + fallback ratio panel (owner: raj)
- [ ] CS: templated customer message + one-click request (owner: amanda_cs)
- [ ] telemetry: emit `fallback_reason` tag (owner: eng-runtime)

raj: I'll prototype the heatmap query and post a short PR tomorrow.
lina: I'll add an API spec for ephemeral limits with `rule_id`, `expires_at`, `owner`, `reason`.
amanda_cs: I'll draft the template and CS checklist and put it in support playbooks.
ben_oncall: Will keep the thread updated during the change. If anyone sees a new spike ping me.
marie: Thanks all — this new runbook + UI action should stop the page-noise and give CS faster remediation.
yr-monitor-bot: alert resolved: PerKey429Spike for acme-prod cleared at 06:45 UTC.
